Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, October 16, 2014 7:09 PM
To: Lowe, John <jlowe@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: World Series/Ausmus 
 
Thank you very much.

Let me know if your schedule changes and I will let you know if I'm available for any other games.
From: Lowe, John
Sent: Thursday, October 16, 2014 6:14 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: Re: World Series/Ausmus 
 
Anthony,
858-405-5969, but don't give it to anyone please.
Thanks for asking about Tuesday night. Right now I have plans, but if they change, I will let you know.

From: Fenech, Anthony
Sent: Thursday, October 16, 2014 1:11 PM
To: Lowe, John
Subject: World Series/Ausmus 
 
John,
Would you like to watch Game 1 on Tuesday night? I am off.
Could you pass along Brad's number? He talked to Lynn earlier in the week and I'm going to reach out and see if he'd be willing to do a Q&A for Sunday's paper.
